documents.unit: UTMB Legal Affairs, Compliance, Information Security, Information Services
documents.title: UTMB Artificial Intelligence (AI) Joint Policy
documents.summary: UTMB's joint policy, adapted from UT Austin, leaves course AI rules to schools and instructors and says that without a syllabus statement AI counts like help from another person or an uncited source. Its firmest rules cover data: no confidential data, FERPA records or health information in public AI tools. Students are responsible for AI content, must verify it and cite it, and nondisclosure violates the conduct policy.
documents.stance_why: The document sets no default allow or ban for coursework: "students must abide by AI policies or statements for the UTMB schools and courses" and "Faculty are strongly encouraged to develop their own policies ... allowing or disallowing some or all uses". Its fixed prohibitions concern data and non-public output, not a course-level stance, so delegates.
